rivers.reason: NPS: Launching at the Hoover Dam (river mile 64) requires a permit. Paddlecraft can launch and takeout at Willow Beach. The Hoover launch is permit/outfitter-controlled, the reach is the NV/AZ border, and the candidate USGS gauges checked gave no recent discharge. Willow Beach NPS POI 20605 (35.86795, -114.66259) was found but not reviewed. Best done with a Nevada package.

FWS: launching at either Topock Marina in Arizona or Park Moabi in California. Topock Marina is a private marina and Park Moabi is in California; FWS gives no coordinates. These boat launches do not provide access to the Colorado River. (Topock Marsh launches). No live gauge found.
FWS non-motorized boating page was 403-blocked; nothing captured.
Reservoir-like, motorboat-dominated reaches on the AZ/CA/NV borders; no agency paddle launch pages captured. Not researched.
Granite Reef is closure-uncertain (closure order link 404s); see closures.json.
No agency coordinate or access page for Gleason Flat was captured (the Tonto rafter take-out pages redirect or 404).
